dedupe_keys.name: wind speed and direction data sets for townsville airport 1993

description: Wind Speed and Direction data sets for Townsville Airport - 1993 is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. This metadata record covers a subset of the data collected during dredging by the Townsville Port Authority in Cleveland Bay in 1993. Data are divided into a number of main groups: Wind, tide gauge, wave rider, S4, sediment traps, water samples and nephelometers. The data are grouped according to collection method and sampling location. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are Oceans | Ocean Winds | Surface Winds, wind_from_direction, wind_speed. It offers 7 resource(s) in html, png, txt, wms. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
